paragraphs: R. Yaakov, the son of Yaakov's daughter. In the chapter HaBoneh (103a); in the chapter Sho'el (149b), two statements. In the name of Ḥunya of Bet Ḥavran, Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Ein Omedin, halakhah 1, and chapter 1 of Shekalim. R. Zeira said to him, 'When you go there, ask R. Yaakov bar Idi,' chapter Ḥallon (80a). Rashi explains: his father was not worthy, so he did not mention him.
